questions.question: Which two numbers and two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct? 18 - 6 + 11 × 5 + 18 = 113
questions.questionHtml:
Which two numbers and two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

18 - 6 + 11 × 5 + 18 = 113
questions.solution:
(3) 6 and 5, - and ×

⇒18 - 6 + 11 × 5 + 18 = 113

After interchanging the signs and numbers:

⇒ 18 × 5 + 11 - 6 + 18 = 113

Apply BODMAS rule:

⇒ 90 + 11 - 6 + 18

⇒ 119 - 6 = 113

⇒ LHS = RHS

⇒ '18 × 5 + 11 - 6 + 18 = 113'

Here, the equation is satisfied.

questions.question: The rule of the English East India company was ended in British India under the Government of India Act, ______.
questions.questionHtml: The rule of the English East India company was ended in British India under the Government of India Act, ______.
questions.solution: The rule of the English East India Company ended in British India under the Government of India Act of 1858. Under this Act, the governance of India was transferred from the company to the British Crown, marking the start of the period of direct rule, also known as the British Raj.

questions.question: Which of the following is a highly electropositive element that readily gives up an electron in order to obtain a stable electronic configuration?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following is a highly electropositive element that readily gives up an electron in order to obtain a stable electronic configuration?
questions.solution: Sodium (Na) is a highly electropositive element. It readily gives up an electron to achieve a stable electronic configuration. Sodium is in the first column of the periodic table, known as the alkali metals group, and these elements all have one electron in their outer shell. They are likely to lose this electron in reactions, making them electropositive. As a result, sodium often forms +1 ions.

questions.question: The famous scientist, Albert Einstein, was inspired by whose idea of non - violence?
questions.questionHtml: The famous scientist, Albert Einstein, was inspired by whose idea of non - violence?
questions.solution: Albert Einstein was known to greatly admire the philosophy and principles advocated by Mahatma Gandhi, particularly the concept of non-violence or "ahimsa". He had corresponded with Gandhi and expressed his admiration. A famous quote attributed to Einstein about Gandhi: "Generations to come, it may well be, will scarce believe that such a man as this one ever in flesh and blood walked upon this Earth".

questions.question: What is the full form of IADP?
questions.questionHtml: What is the full form of IADP?
questions.solution: IADP was the first major experiment in India's agricultural sector towards increasing agricultural production after Indian independence. It was introduced in 1960 in the wake of the success of community development programmes which aimed to increase the income and improve the standard of living of farmers. The primary objective of the IADP was to increase overall agricultural production in a sustainable manner, while also increasing the incomes of farmers.

questions.question: Where in India are the Sundari trees that provide durable and hard timber found?
questions.questionHtml: Where in India are the Sundari trees that provide durable and hard timber found?
questions.solution: The Sundari trees, scientifically known as Heritiera fomes, are found in India's mangrove forests, particularly in the Sundarbans, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The Sundarbans are located in the delta region of the Padma, Meghna, and Brahmaputra river basins, spanning Bangladesh and West Bengal. Adapted to saline and waterlogged environments, Sundari trees provide high-quality, durable, termite-resistant timber. However, climate change, rising sea levels, and logging threaten their population. India's forests are diverse, including Tropical Evergreen, Semi-Evergreen, Moist and Dry Deciduous, Thorn, Montane, Littoral, Swamp, and Mangrove forests.

questions.solution: Domestic income, also known as Gross Domestic Product, is the total income earned by all sectors (households, firms, and the government) within the geographical boundaries of a country, irrespective of whether they are residents or non-residents. However, income earned by non-residents outside the country is NOT included in the domestic income. Such income is part of the national income, not domestic income.

questions.question: As per National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5) 2019 - 21, what percentage of women have a bank or savings account that they themselves use?
questions.questionHtml: As per National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5) 2019 - 21, what percentage of women have a bank or savings account that they themselves use?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 78.6%.Key Points

  • Union Minister for Health and Family Welfare, Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya released the National Report of the fifth round of National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5).
  • The report comprises of detailed information on key domains of population, health and family welfare and associated domains like characteristics of the population; fertility; family planning; infant and child mortality; maternal and child health; nutrition and anaemia; morbidity and healthcare; women’s empowerment etc.

Additional Information

The National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5) 2019-2021 has many key findings, including: 

  • The sex ratio was 1,020 women for every 1,000 men.  
  •  The under-five mortality rate dropped from 50 deaths per 1,000 live births in 2015-16 to 42 deaths per 1,000 in 2019-21.
  • The infant mortality rate also declined from 41 deaths per 1,000 live births to 35 deaths per 1,000 live births. 
  •  The percentage of 20–24 year old girls who married before age 18 decreased from 26.8% to 23.3%. 
  • The adolescent fertility rate (women aged 15–19) decreased from 51% to 43%.

questions.question: Mitochondria is NOT found in ______.
questions.questionHtml: Mitochondria is NOT found in ______.
questions.solution: Mitochondria are not found in bacteria. Bacteria are prokaryotic cells and do not contain organelles, such as mitochondria, that are found in eukaryotic cells. It's interesting to note that it's widely accepted that mitochondria originated from a type of prokaryote due to a symbiotic event in the distant past, a theory known as endosymbiosis.

questions.solution: Bacteria are a separate domain of life and are not related to the phylum Arthropoda. Arthropoda is the phylum that includes insects, spiders, crustaceans, and other similar creatures, all of which are multicellular and have exoskeletons, segmented bodies, and paired, jointed appendages. questions.question: Which of the following amendment acts included Fundamental Duties in the Constitution of India?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following amendment acts included Fundamental Duties in the Constitution of India?
questions.solution: The Fundamental Duties of citizens were added to the Indian Constitution by the 42nd Amendment Act in 1976, during the period of the Emergency (1975-77). This was done upon the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee that was constituted by the government in 1976. The Committee had recommended the inclusion of a separate chapter in the Constitution on Fundamental Duties. As a result, Part IVA was inserted into the Constitution, with Article 51A defining the Fundamental Duties.

questions.question: Suresh and Anil are working on a special project. Suresh takes 5 hours to type 40 pages and Anil needs 6 hours to type 32 pages on a computer. How much time will it take them to type a 110 - page assignment if they work on two different computers?
questions.questionHtml: Suresh and Anil are working on a special project. Suresh takes 5 hours to type 40 pages and Anil needs 6 hours to type 32 pages on a computer. How much time will it take them to type a 110 - page assignment if they work on two different computers?
questions.solution:
Given:

Suresh can type 40 pages in 5 hours

Anil can type 32 pages in 6 hours

Concept Used:

Total Work = Efficiency × Time Required

Calculations:

Let the total work be of 160 pages (LCM of 40 and 32)

To type 160 pages

Time required by Suresh = 5 × 4 = 20 hours

Time required by Anil = 6 × 5 = 30 hours

⇒ Efficiency of Suresh = 160/20 = 8 pages/hr

⇒ Efficiency of Anil = 160/30 = (16/3) pages/hr

Combines efficiency = 8 + (16/3) = (40/3) pages/hr

Time required by Suresh and Anil to type 110 pages

⇒ 110/(40/3) = 33/4 = 8\(\frac{1}{4}\) hours = 8 hours 15 minutes

questions.questionHtml:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The shopman was very interested in selling this creamy box to her as he would gain a big margin.

B. The man on the counter showed her 'an exquisite little enamel box' with a very fine glaze as if baked in cream.

C. As the box was too expensive, priced twenty - eight guineas, she asked the shopkeeper to keep it for her.

D. She went inside a little antique shop in Curzon Street. This was the usual shop where the shopkeeper was ridiculously fond of serving her.
questions.solution: In the given question, the subject of the passage i.e. " the woman" is first mentioned in and introduced by the sentence D. The passage will end with the women asking to reserve the box for her. Thus, sentence C will be the concluding sentence. In between the sentence B and then sentence A will be fitted in chronological order.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. They will not water the plants.

options.text: They shall not water the plants.
options.html: They shall not water the plants.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1, "The plants will not be watered by them."

Key Points:
- The sentence is in active voice, with "they" as the subject and "water" as the verb.
- To change it to passive voice, we need to make the object (the plants) the subject and use the passive form of the verb ("will be watered").
- The preposition "by" is used to indicate who is performing the action (in this case, "them").
- The negative "not" stays in the same position in the sentence.

Additional Information:
- Option 2 ("The plants will not be watered by us") changes the subject to "us" instead of "them."
- Option 3 ("The plants are not be watered by them") has an incorrect verb form ("are" instead of "will be").
- Option 4 ("They shall not water the plants") is in active voice and does not use the passive form of the verb.
- Option 5 is blank.
